1: # JCROWN DIGITALS — Technical Specification
2: 
3: ## 1. Concept & Vision
4: 
5: JCROWN DIGITALS is a premium personal-brand website for Jediah Akeredolu — a digital publications platform that feels like stepping into a private library, not a storefront. The experience is confident, intelligent, and luxurious: deep blacks contrasted with restrained gold accents create a sense of exclusivity and trust. Every interaction is purposeful; every page tells Jediah's story first, then guides visitors to his work.
6: 
7: **Primary visitor journey:** Discover JCrown -> Learn about Jediah -> Click "DOWNLOAD BOOKS HERE" -> Browse and download available books.
8: 
9: ---
10: 
11: ## 2. Design Language
12: 
13: ### Aesthetic Direction
14: Inspired by luxury editorial design and premium publishing houses — think Monocle magazine meets a private members' club. Clean, spacious, authoritative.
15: 
16: ### Color Palette
17: | Role | Color | Hex |
18: |------|-------|-----|
19: | Background (primary) | Rich Black | `#0A0A0A` |
20: | Background (secondary) | Charcoal | `#1A1A1A` |
21: | Background (panels) | Dark Gray | `#141414` |
22: | Accent (primary) | Royal Gold | `#C9A84C` |
23: | Accent (hover) | Bright Gold | `#D4B85A` |
24: | Text (primary) | Ivory | `#F5F0E8` |
25: | Text (secondary) | Muted Ivory | `#C8C0B0` |
26: | Text (dark bg) | White | `#FFFFFF` |
27: | Border/Divider | Subtle Gold | `#3A3A3A` |
28: | Success | Muted Green | `#4CAF50` |
29: | Error | Muted Red | `#E57373` |
30: 
31: ### Typography
32: - **Headings:** Playfair Display (serif) — elegant, editorial authority
33: - **Body:** Inter (sans-serif) — clean, readable, modern
34: - **Fallbacks:** Georgia, serif / system-ui, sans-serif
35: 
36: ### Spatial System
37: - Base unit: 8px
38: - Section padding: 80px–120px vertical
39: - Container max-width: 1200px
40: - Card gap: 32px
41: - Border radius: 4px (subtle, not rounded)
42: 
43: ### Motion Philosophy
44: - Scroll-triggered fade-up reveals: 600ms ease-out
45: - Button hover: 200ms color + subtle lift (translateY -2px)
46: - Page transitions: none (instant, for speed)
47: - Smooth scroll behavior with 80px offset for fixed header
48: - Focus states: gold outline, 2px offset
49: 
50: ### Visual Assets
51: - Icons: Lucide icons (line style, 1.5px stroke)
52: - Book covers: Admin-uploaded images, displayed in 3:4 ratio frames
53: - Portrait: Admin-uploaded, displayed in subtle gold-bordered circle
54: - Decorative: Subtle gradient overlays, fine gold dividers
55: 
56: ---
57: 
58: ## 3. Layout & Structure
59: 
60: ### Public Site Structure
61: ```
62: / (Homepage)
63:   ├── Navigation (fixed, transparent → solid on scroll)
64:   ├── Hero (100vh, centered, book mockup visual)
65:   ├── About Jediah (two-column: portrait + text)
66:   ├── What JCROWN Offers (three feature cards)
67:   ├── Download CTA (centered gold button)
68:   ├── Books Section (#books, card grid)
69:   ├── Newsletter (centered subscription)
70:   ├── Contact (two-column: info + form)
71:   └── Footer (minimal, links)
72: ```
73: 
74: ### Admin Structure
75: ```
76: /admin
77:   ├── Login
78:   └── Dashboard
79:       ├── Overview (stats)
80:       ├── Books Management (CRUD)
81:       ├── Homepage Content Editor
82:       ├── Subscriber Management
83:       └── Contact Messages
84: ```
85: 
86: ### Responsive Strategy
87: - Desktop: 1200px container, multi-column layouts
88: - Tablet (768px): 2-column grids, adjusted spacing
89: - Mobile (480px): single column, full-width cards, hamburger nav
90: 
91: ---
92: 
93: ## 4. Features & Interactions
94: 
95: ### Navigation
96: - Fixed header, 70px height, transitions from transparent to `#0A0A0A` on scroll
97: - Logo left, nav links right
98: - Mobile: hamburger menu, full-screen overlay
99: - Active section highlighting via scroll spy
100: - Smooth scroll to anchors with 80px offset
101: 
102: ### Hero Section
103: - Full viewport height
104: - Centered content: wordmark, welcome text, quote
105: - Subtle animated book stack or floating eBook covers
106: - Scroll indicator (chevron) at bottom
107: 
108: ### About Section
109: - Two columns: portrait (40%) + bio text (60%)
110: - Gold divider line between portrait and text
111: - Editable text via admin
112: 
113: ### What We Offer
114: - Three cards in a row (stacked on mobile)
115: - Each: icon, heading, short description
116: - Subtle hover: lift + gold border glow
117: 
118: ### Download CTA Button
119: - Large gold button, centered
120: - Label: "DOWNLOAD BOOKS HERE"
121: - Links to `#books` with smooth scroll + 80px offset
122: - Keyboard accessible, visible focus/hover states
123: 
124: ### Books Section (#books)
125: - Grid of book cards
126: - Each card: cover image, title, description, author, format badge, price label, action button
127: - Free books: "Download Free" button → direct file download (no login required)
128: - Paid books: "Get This Book" → checkout flow (Stripe or placeholder)
129: - Empty state: "New publications are coming soon" message
130: - Only published books shown
131: 
132: ### Newsletter Section
133: - Email input + "Subscribe for Updates" button
134: - Client + server validation (valid email format)
135: - Success: "Thank you for subscribing!" message
136: - Error: specific error message displayed
137: - Stores subscribers in database
138: 
139: ### Contact Section
140: - Fields: Name, Email, Subject, Message
141: - Client + server validation
142: - Success: "Message sent successfully" + form reset
143: - Error: "Failed to send. Please try again."
144: - Stores messages in database
145: 
146: ### Footer
147: - Brand name, copyright
148: - Quick links (scroll to sections)
149: - Privacy Policy, Terms pages
150: - Social links (configurable in admin)
151: 
152: ---
153: 
154: ## 5. Component Inventory
155: 
156: ### Button (Primary)
157: - Default: Gold `#C9A84C` bg, black text, 4px radius
158: - Hover: Lighter gold `#D4B85A`, translateY(-2px), subtle shadow
159: - Active: Darker gold, translateY(0)
160: - Disabled: 50% opacity, no pointer
161: - Focus: 2px gold outline, 2px offset
162: 
163: ### Button (Secondary/Ghost)
164: - Default: Transparent bg, gold border, gold text
165: - Hover: Gold bg at 10% opacity
166: - Focus: Gold outline
167: 
168: ### Book Card
169: - Dark panel `#141414`, subtle border
170: - Cover image (3:4), title, description (2-line clamp), format badge, price
171: - Hover: border brightens to gold, subtle lift
172: - Action button at bottom
173: 
174: ### Input Field
175: - Dark bg `#1A1A1A`, subtle border
176: - Focus: gold border, no outline
177: - Error: red border + error message below
178: - Placeholder: muted ivory
179: 
180: ### Navigation Link
181: - Default: ivory text
182: - Hover: gold text, no underline
183: - Active: gold text, subtle underline
184: 
185: ---
186: 
187: ## 6. Technical Approach
188: 
189: ### Stack
190: - **Runtime:** Node.js 18+
191: - **Framework:** Express.js
192: - **Template Engine:** EJS
193: - **Database:** SQLite (better-sqlite3 for sync operations)
194: - **File Storage:** Local filesystem (`/public/uploads/`)
195: - **Authentication:** Express sessions + bcrypt
196: - **Payments:** Stripe (optional, configured via env)
197: 
198: ### API Design
199: 
200: #### Public
201: | Method | Route | Description |
202: |--------|-------|-------------|
203: | GET | `/` | Homepage |
204: | GET | `/admin` | Admin login page |
205: | POST | `/admin/login` | Authenticate admin |
206: | POST | `/admin/logout` | End session |
207: | POST | `/api/subscribe` | Newsletter signup |
208: | POST | `/api/contact` | Submit contact form |
209: | GET | `/api/books` | List published books |
210: | GET | `/download/:bookId` | Download free book file |
211: 
212: #### Admin (protected)
213: | Method | Route | Description |
214: |--------|-------|-------------|
215: | GET | `/admin/dashboard` | Dashboard overview |
216: | GET | `/admin/books` | Book management list |
217: | POST | `/admin/books` | Create book |
218: | PUT | `/admin/books/:id` | Update book |
219: | DELETE | `/admin/books/:id` | Delete book |
220: | PUT | `/admin/content` | Update homepage content |
221: | GET | `/admin/subscribers` | View subscribers |
222: | DELETE | `/admin/subscribers/:id` | Unsubscribe |
223: | GET | `/admin/messages` | View contact messages |
224: | PUT | `/admin/settings` | Update site settings |
225: 
226: ### Data Model
227: 
228: #### books
229: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
230: - title (TEXT)
231: - description (TEXT)
232: - author (TEXT, default "Jediah Akeredolu")
233: - cover_image (TEXT, filepath)
234: - file_path (TEXT, filepath)
235: - file_format (TEXT, e.g. "PDF")
236: - price (REAL, 0 for free)
237: - is_free (INTEGER, 0/1)
238: - is_published (INTEGER, 0/1)
239: - download_count (INTEGER, default 0)
240: - created_at (DATETIME)
241: - updated_at (DATETIME)
242: 
243: #### subscribers
244: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
245: - email (TEXT UNIQUE)
246: - is_active (INTEGER, default 1)
247: - subscribed_at (DATETIME)
248: - unsubscribed_at (DATETIME)
249: 
250: #### contacts
251: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
252: - name (TEXT)
253: - email (TEXT)
254: - subject (TEXT)
255: - message (TEXT)
256: - is_read (INTEGER, default 0)
257: - created_at (DATETIME)
258: 
259: #### admin_users
260: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
261: - username (TEXT UNIQUE)
262: - password_hash (TEXT)
263: - created_at (DATETIME)
264: 
265: #### site_content
266: - id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
267: - section (TEXT, e.g. "hero", "about", "offers")
268: - content (TEXT, JSON)
269: - updated_at (DATETIME)
270: 
271: ### Authentication
272: - Session-based with `express-session`
273: - Bcrypt password hashing (cost factor 12)
274: - Session stored in SQLite
275: - Protected routes check session admin flag
276: - CSRF protection on forms
277: 
278: ### File Handling
279: - Multer for upload middleware
280: - Allowed extensions: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp (covers); .pdf, .epub, .mobi (books)
281: - Max file size: 10MB covers, 50MB books
282: - Files stored in `/public/uploads/covers/` and `/public/uploads/books/`
283: - Filenames sanitized with UUID
284: 
285: ### Security
286: - Input sanitization on all user inputs
287: - Parameterized queries (no raw SQL interpolation)
288: - XSS prevention via EJS escaping
289: - CSRF tokens on all forms
290: - Rate limiting on contact/subscribe endpoints
291: - Secure password requirements for admin
292: 
293: ---
294: 
295: ## 7. Pages & States
296: 
297: ### Homepage
298: - All 9 sections visible
299: - Books section shows published books or empty state
300: - Navigation highlights current section
301: 
302: ### Book Detail (inline in grid)
303: - Card shows all info
304: - Click download: triggers file download for free books
305: - Click purchase: opens checkout or payment modal
306: 
307: ### Admin Login
308: - Username + password fields
309: - Error states for invalid credentials
310: - Redirect to dashboard on success
311: 
312: ### Admin Dashboard
313: - Stats cards: total books, subscribers, messages, downloads
314: - Quick actions: Add Book, Edit Content, View Messages
315: 
316: ### Book Management
317: - Table of all books (published + draft)
318: - Add/Edit modal or page
319: - Upload cover + file
320: - Toggle free/paid, published status
321: 
322: ### Empty States
323: - No books: "New publications are coming soon"
324: - No subscribers: "No subscribers yet"
325: - No messages: "No messages yet"
326: 
327: ---
328: 
329: ## 8. SEO & Metadata
330: 
331: - Title: "JCROWN DIGITALS — Jediah Akeredolu"
332: - Description: "Discover digital publications and resources by Jediah Akeredolu. Explore books, access free resources, and stay updated with JCROWN DIGITALS."
333: - OG tags for social sharing
334: - Semantic HTML (header, main, section, article, footer)
335: - Canonical URL
336: 
337: ---
338: 
339: ## 9. Setup & Deployment
340: 
341: ### Requirements
342: - Node.js 18+
343: - npm
344: 
345: ### Installation
346: ```bash
347: npm install
348: npm run setup    # Creates admin user, DB tables
349: npm start        # Runs on http://localhost:3000
350: ```
351: 
352: ### Environment Variables
353: - `SESSION_SECRET` — session encryption key
354: - `ADMIN_USERNAME` — default admin username
355: - `ADMIN_PASSWORD` — default admin password
356: - `STRIPE_KEY` — Stripe API key (optional)
